prompts.farmland:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: polished background for an offline side-view railway game for children under six. Style: semi-realistic colourful 3D storybook diorama, polished commercial videogame environment, believable proportions, layered depth, softly rendered materials, rich yet uncluttered scenery; cohesive daylight style across the set. Composition: broad horizontal landscape panorama, aspect ratio approximately 2:1. Fixed side-view camera looking across terrain, not down a road. Upper 35 percent sky, middle 35 percent distant scenery and landmarks, lower 30 percent an uninterrupted flat horizontal strip of sunlit grass and fine ballast. The foreground is reserved for a separately overlaid train and horizontal railway: absolutely keep this whole lower strip open, flat, quiet and empty, with no objects obscuring it. Warm sunlight from upper left, soft shadows, clear blue sky, pleasant natural greens and warm stone colours. Avoid: trains, engines, characters, faces, train cars, tracks, rails, roads in the foreground, signs, signal posts, fences in foreground, foreground trees, obstacles, text, logos, labels, UI, frames, collage. Render one complete landscape, not a contact sheet.
Scene/backdrop: English farmland and a small distant village: rolling green and golden fields divided by hedgerows, believable stone farm cottages, a red-tiled barn, tiny fruit trees and a distant church spire. Countryside scenery suitable for a cheerful child's railway journey.
